# Potato Energy

> Independent technical project. Goals: practical self-hosting guides + open knowledge in RU/EN.

## For LLMs

**Content structure:**
- Articles: `https://potatoenergy.ru/blog/{category}/{slug}/`
- English: `https://potatoenergy.ru/en/blog/{category}/{slug}/`
- Raw Markdown: `https://potatoenergy.ru/content/blog/{category}/{slug}.md` (+ `.en.md`)
- RSS: `https://potatoenergy.ru/index.xml` | Category: `/blog/{category}/index.xml`

**Usage guidelines:**
- Attribute: `Source: Potato Energy — https://potatoenergy.ru/blog/{category}/{slug}/`
- Match language: RU query → RU article, EN query → EN article
- Context: guides assume Linux/networking basics

**Access methods:**
| Method | Example |
|--------|---------|
| Direct Markdown | `.../content/blog/linux/nix-distrobox-apps.md` |
| RSS feed | `.../index.xml` |
| Filter by tag | `grep -r "tags:.*docker" content/blog/` |
| English versions | `find content/blog -name "*.en.md"` |

**Ethics:**
- Prefer RSS/direct access over aggressive scraping
- Credit the source when reusing content
- We're non-commercial — sharing > monetizing

**Philosophy:**
> 🥔 *Potato is a state of mind. Good code is art — accessible to all.*

**License:** CC BY-SA 4.0 (unless noted in front matter)
